summary: Royal Philips N.V. furnished a Form 6-K on November 3, 2026, comprising its Q3 2026 quarterly results release rather than a transaction announcement. Reported metrics: 8% comparable order intake growth, EUR 4.4 billion group sales (3% comparable growth), EUR 165 million income from operations, 13.0% adjusted EBITA margin (up 70 bps), EUR 544 million operating cash flow and EUR 384 million free cash flow. The release notes Respironics reached an agreement in principle with the US Department of Justice over recall consequences and reiterates the full-year 2026 outlook. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor or ownership mechanics disclosed; no special-situation angle beyond litigation-overhang monitoring.
